import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,tarfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
C=pathlib.Path.cwd(); base=C/'docs/evidence/runs/2026-09-14-cost-equivalence'; sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
summary={'schema':1}
sources={}
for rel in ('src/orze/core/cpu_action_budget.py','src/orze/engine/idea_ingress.py','src/orze/idea_lake.py'):
 raw=(base/'baseline'/rel).read_bytes()
 assert raw==subprocess.check_output(['git','show','e606ba6688b4e1972e26a08617821a427668dd24:'+rel])
 sources[rel]={'sha256':sha(raw),'bytes':len(raw)}
summary['whole_baseline_git_exact']=sources
arch=json.loads((base/'archive-result.json').read_bytes()); totals={'files':0,'symlinks':0,'copied_files':0}
for item in arch['archives']:
 index=C/item['index']; assert sha(index.read_bytes())==item['index_sha256']
 data=json.loads(index.read_bytes()); archive=C/data['archive']; assert sha(archive.read_bytes())==data['archive_sha256']
 with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
  for row in data['entries']:
   m=tar.getmember('raw/'+row['path'])
   if row['type']=='file':
    raw=tar.extractfile(m).read();assert sha(raw)==row['sha256'] and len(raw)==row['bytes']
    assert (pathlib.Path(data['original'])/row['path']).read_bytes()==raw;totals['files']+=1
   else: assert m.issym() and m.linkname==row['target'];totals['symlinks']+=1
 for row in data['copies']:
  raw=(C/row['path']).read_bytes();assert raw==pathlib.Path(row['original']).read_bytes()
  assert sha(raw)==row['sha256'] and len(raw)==row['bytes'];totals['copied_files']+=1
summary['archive_byte_exact']=totals
reports=[json.loads(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted((base/'metadata-equivalence/reports').glob('*.json'))]
assert len(reports)==23
for r in reports:
 for point in r['point_reads']: assert point['old']==point['new']
 if r['case']!='alias_existing_target':assert r['totals']['old']==r['totals']['new']
alias=next(r for r in reports if r['case']=='alias_existing_target')
assert alias['totals']['old']=={'accepted':True,'value':[4000000000,{}]}
assert alias['totals']['new']=={'accepted':False,'exception':'CpuBudgetHOLD','reason':'cpu_budget_permit_changed'}
summary['differential']={'cases':23,'exact_nonalias_totals_including_errors':22,'all_point_reads_exact':True,'intentional_safety_fix':alias['totals']}
test=C/'tests/test_cpu_budget_scan_review.py'
summary['new_test']={'sha256':sha(test.read_bytes()),'literal_asserts':sum(isinstance(n,ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(test.read_text())))}
counts={}
for label,expected in [('metadata-equivalence',23),('real-regression',12)]:
 root=ET.parse(base/label/'junit.xml').getroot(); cases=root.findall('.//testcase')
 assert len(cases)==expected and len({(n.get('classname'),n.get('name')) for n in cases})==expected
 assert not any(n.find(x) is not None for n in cases for x in ('failure','error','skipped'))
 run=json.loads((base/label/'run.json').read_bytes())
 assert run['exit_code']==0 and run['before']==run['after']
 for name in ('stdout','stderr'): assert sha((base/label/(name+'.log')).read_bytes())==run[name+'_sha256']
 counts[label]={'passed':expected,'skip':0,'failure':0,'source_hashes_exact':len(run['before'])}
summary['junit']=counts
scale=json.loads((base/'scale/reports/00-report.json').read_bytes())
assert scale['before']==scale['after']
for rel,h in scale['after'].items():
 assert sha((C/rel).read_bytes())==h
 assert sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','df446ab35e745daf02cc7c4a19cadffd57518103:'+rel]))==h
summary['final_source_commit']='df446ab35e745daf02cc7c4a19cadffd57518103'
summary['scale_rows']=[]
for r in scale['rows']:
 n=r['rows_in_scope']; assert r['rows_in_other_scope']==n and r['ledger_sha256_before']==r['ledger_sha256_after']
 assert r['old_totals_trace']['sql_count']==n+1 and r['new_totals_trace']['sql_count']==1
 assert r['old_totals_trace']['decode_calls']==r['new_totals_trace']['decode_calls']==5*n
 assert r['old_empty_ingress_trace']['sql_count']==1 and r['new_empty_ingress_trace']['sql_count']==0
 for metric in ('totals','snapshot','empty_ingress'):
  for arm in ('old','new'): assert len(r[metric][arm]['seconds'])==5
 summary['scale_rows'].append({'n':n,'totals_sql':[n+1,1],'decode_calls_per_arm':5*n,'totals_seconds':[r['totals']['old']['median_seconds'],r['totals']['new']['median_seconds']],'snapshot_seconds':[r['snapshot']['old']['median_seconds'],r['snapshot']['new']['median_seconds']],'ingress_seconds':[r['empty_ingress']['old']['median_seconds'],r['empty_ingress']['new']['median_seconds']]})
summary['real_recovery']=[]
for path in sorted((base/'real-regression/reports').glob('*.json')):
 r=json.loads(path.read_bytes()); snapshots={s['label']:s for s in r['snapshots']}; calls=r['calls']
 for call in calls:
  tree=call['controller_closure'];assert tree['event']=='TREE_CLOSED' and tree['wait_proof']=='ECHILD_WALL'
  assert tree['binding']==call['controller_binding'] and tree['worker_returncode']==call['exit_code']
 crash=next(call for call in calls if call['exit_code']==86); meta=next(m for m in crash['metadata'] if m.get('event')=='crash_before_settle')
 assert meta['effect_confirmed'] is True and meta['effect_guard_absent'] is True and meta['transaction_open'] is False
 before=snapshots[crash['after']];after=r['snapshots'][-1]
 for row in before['database']['execution_attempts']:
  ref={k:row[k] for k in ('task_id','phase','attempt_id','generation')}
  terminal=json.loads(row['terminal_json']); binding=json.loads(row['binding_json'])
  tree=terminal['process_tree'];assert row['state']=='TERMINAL' and tree['event']=='TREE_CLOSED' and tree['wait_proof']=='ECHILD_WALL'
  assert tree['binding']==binding['supervision'] and tree['binding']['identity']['attempt_ref']==ref
  folder=pathlib.Path(binding['scope'])/'_execution_effects'/ref['attempt_id']
  prepared=before['files'][str(folder/'prepared.json')]; committed=before['files'][str(folder/'committed.json')]
  assert sha(prepared['utf8'].encode())==prepared['sha256']==terminal['effect_receipt_sha256']
  payload=json.loads(committed['utf8']);assert payload['prepared_sha256']==prepared['sha256']
  assert {k:payload[k] for k in ref}==ref
 if 'domain_events' in r:
  assert [c['exit_code'] for c in calls]==[0,86,0,0]
  assert len([e for e in r['domain_events'] if e['event']=='native_ready'])==2
  assert len([e for e in r['domain_events'] if e['event']=='interpret'])==2
  for table in ('execution_attempts','research_artifacts','research_observations','idea_state','idea_transitions','idea_stage_state','idea_stage_transitions','ideas'):
   assert before['database'][table]==after['database'][table]
  assert before['files']==after['files']
  assert all(x['state']=='SETTLED' for x in after['database']['cpu_action_reservations'])
  assert sum(int(json.loads(x['permit_json'])['reserved_nanoseconds']) for x in after['database']['cpu_action_reservations'])==4000000000
  obs=json.loads(after['database']['research_observations'][0]['record_json'])
  item={'cli_exits':[0,86,0,0],'native_ready':2,'interpret':2,'observation_status':obs['validation']['status'],'charge_ns':4000000000,'post_recovery_settled':2,'business_rows_and_files_unchanged':True}
 else:
  assert [c['exit_code'] for c in calls]==[86,75]
  actual_before=snapshots[calls[-1]['before']]
  for table in ('execution_attempts','research_artifacts','research_observations','ideas','idea_state','idea_stage_state','cpu_action_reservations'):
   assert actual_before['database'][table]==after['database'][table]
  assert actual_before['files']==after['files'] and actual_before['worker_events']==after['worker_events']
  assert len(after['database']['cpu_action_reservations'])==1 and after['database']['cpu_action_reservations'][0]['state']=='BOUND'
  item={'cli_exits':[86,75],'unchanged_worker_events':1,'retained_bound':1,'no_retry_admission':True}
 item.update({'path':str(path.relative_to(C)),'sha256':sha(path.read_bytes())})
 summary['real_recovery'].append(item)
print(json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True))
PY
